evidence.what: Vertical bar pull standing proud at the bed-side edge of the LEFT nightstand's room-facing drawer front (no such hardware on its outer corner) - graspable from open room space.
Thin uniform shadow reveal between the inset drawer face and the bottom frame rail on the LEFT nightstand's room-facing face - inset-drawer gap, not a deep fixed-panel recess.
Mirrored vertical bar pull at the bed-side edge of the RIGHT nightstand's room-facing drawer front, catching room light - drawer hardware facing open room space.
Same thin uniform drawer reveal along the bottom of the RIGHT nightstand's room-facing inset drawer face.
Wardrobe-camera oblique of the same wardrobe-side nightstand: the framed drawer front with its edge pull faces the open room (toward the foot of the room), not the bed.

note: Judged blind from pixels only. Both nightstands present, on the face oriented toward the open room (toward the p2r76 camera at the foot of the bed), a full-width inset drawer front: a thin uniform reveal gap around the panel plus a proud vertical bar pull mounted at the bed-adjacent edge of that front. The pulls are mirrored about the bed (left unit: right edge; right unit: left edge) and absent from the outer corners, which reads as hardware, not structure. Pulling from these bars opens the drawer into open room space. Caveat for the next builder: the bed-facing side faces of both units are occluded by the mattress in both frames, so nothing is asserted about what is on those sides - only that an operable drawer front demonstrably faces the room.

overturned.what: The Asta model has exactly ONE face with a pull — a routed recess, visible only in the S elevation (probe/front_S.png); the N elevation (probe/front_N.png) is a blank framed back with no hardware. Under the pinned convention (front=(sin rot,-cos rot)) the spec rot 90 put that pulled face at +X, INSIDE wall BF14 which both tables hug — so the faces this verdict arrowed as fronts are the framed BACKS, and the two 'pulls' were frame stiles read at render resolution. The owner said it from the frame: หันหน้าเข้ากำแพง.
overturned.consequence: This VISIBLE no longer supports closure. The fix is derived facing (facing_derive away_from_wall E -> rot 270, placement.face_rot) with the native front measured -90 in qa/model-front-registry.json; re-run this verifier on the frame that carries it (p2r77+).
overturned.triage: R7: a refutation carries a measurement, never taste. The eye finds WHAT (a credible drawer-front read); the measurement finds WHICH WAY (the probe + the convention algebra).
